big_a_landmarks.prompt: {STYLE} One large city for a turn-based civilization strategy map, painted in exactly the gouache style, colours and roof style of the reference town. Seen from HIGH above at only a slight angle: mostly rooftops, with a thin sliver of south-facing walls visible, leaning the same way as the units in the reference map but much less. It must read clearly when shrunk to a 64-pixel map tile: bold shapes, strong near-black outlines, very high contrast, no fussy detail. Its footprint is a SQUARE filling the picture edge to edge; nothing sticks out beyond the square. A dense grid of terracotta-roofed houses, and rising clearly above them three tall landmarks: a big palace with a golden dome in the middle, a tall columned temple, and a slender watchtower. The landmarks are much larger and brighter than the houses so the city reads as important. Isolated on a perfectly flat, uniform pure magenta (#FF00FF) background. No shadow, no text, no frame, no pink or purple in the painting.
